title: Relative singular-ideal containment from an annihilator bound
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $D$ a finitely presented $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], $B$ a commutative $R$-algebra, and $d_B:D\to B$ an $R$-algebra map making $B$ finitely presented over $D$. Let $\pi\in R$ satisfy $\operatorname{Ann}_R(\pi)=\operatorname{Ann}_R(\pi^2)$. Write $p$ for its image in $D$, and $T=\{r\in D\mid\forall x\in D,\ p^2x=0\Rightarrow rpx=0\}$. If the ideal generated by $d_B(T)$ is contained in $H_{B/D}$, then $H_{D/R}B\subset H_{B/D}$ and $H_{D/R}B\subset H_{B/R}$, with $H$ the singular ideals [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal] and the $D$-algebra structure on $B$ induced by $d_B$. : Ideal.map dB.toRingHom (singularIdeal R D) ≤ @singularIdeal D B _ _ dB.toRingHom.toAlgebra

source.place: Stacks Tag 07CT, proof: Flat-prime support argument and smooth composition

proof.text: Since D is finitely presented over the Noetherian ring R, it is of finite type and Noetherian. Put p = algebraMap R D π and I = Ann_D(p²); I is finitely generated by the definition of Noetherianity.

For each g in smoothElements R D, D_g is smooth and hence flat over R. Apply annihilator_element_flat_base_change to π and π². The equality Ann_R(π) = Ann_R(π²) implies Ann_{D_g}(π) = Ann_{D_g}(π²). Thus for x in I the image of px in D_g is zero.

The localization zero criterion gives, for each x in I, an exponent n with g^n(px) = 0. Choose a finite spanning set for I. Induction on that finite set, using the sum of two exponents at an insertion, supplies one exponent n valid for every generator. Multiplication by g^n p is D-linear, so vanishing on the generators is vanishing on I. This is the proved private helper exists_uniform_power; it constructs no data from an unproved existence theorem.
Hence g^n belongs to T = {r : D | for all x, p²x = 0 implies rpx = 0}. The assumed span bound gives dB(g)^n = dB(g^n) in H_{B/D}. Since that ideal is radical, dB(g) belongs to it.

The preceding generator containment gives span(smoothElements R D) contained in the inverse image of H_{B/D}. That inverse image is radical (Ideal.IsRadical.comap), so Ideal.IsRadical.radical_le_iff gives containment of singularIdeal R D. Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap is the desired conclusion.
